groups.canonical_name: International and global minimum tax changes
groups.definition: Changes to international tax rules such as OECD BEPS and Pillar 2 global minimum tax could raise the company's effective tax rate and tax liabilities.

groups.canonical_name: Tax law changes and incentive realization
groups.definition: Tax audits, tax law changes and uncertainty over realizing IRA tax incentives and deferred tax assets could increase tax costs and reduce earnings.
Government grants, subsidies and tax incentives received for investments may be reduced, terminated or clawed back if conditions are not met, harming financial results.
